findings.description: setRoute accepts any path whose LAST non-zero entry is sya.rewardToken(). Curve Router NG (verified source, exchange loop) breaks after hop i when `_route[i*2+3] == empty(address)` and transfers `_route[(i+1)*2]` to the receiver, so a path with an interior zero gap delivers the intermediate token. swapParams/pools are also never checked against the path.
findings.codeSnippet:
for (uint256 i = 0; i < 11; i++) { if (path[i] != address(0)) { last = path[i]; } }
if (last != rewardToken) revert InvalidRouteEnd(rewardToken, last);
findings.attackVector: Owner footgun (non-obvious: the validation is advertised as the route-end guard). Fork: route [USDe, poolUSDe/crvUSD, crvUSD, 0,...,0, USDC] is accepted; Router NG delivers crvUSD. Contrary to the Tier-1 prediction (loud underflow revert), the full harvest SUCCEEDS because the USDC-strategy yield + DOLA sale cover `owed`; 4.293593 crvUSD (the whole USDe-yield sale) is left permanently in the harvester (crvUSD is not a strategy token, so _sellYield never touches it; no sweep). The keeper's simulation shows the lower ethOut and harvest.sh happily submits; every subsequent harvest strands that strategy's yield again. MockCurveRouter implements the same last-non-zero rule, so the unit suite cannot detect this.
findings.impact: Silent, recurring loss of the caller's paid-for yield (SYA is still paid in full). No third-party theft.
findings.recommendation: Validate contiguity: let k = first index with path[2k+1]==0; require path[2k]==rewardToken and every slot after 2k zero; optionally require swapParams rows beyond k-1 to be zero. Add an end-of-callback assertion that every touched non-reward token balance is zero, or make MockCurveRouter follow Router NG semantics.

findings.description: _sellYield acts on the harvester's raw balanceOf, not on what SYA delivered this call, and does not mirror SYA's `tokenConfigs[token].paused` skip. When a non-exempt strategy delivers nothing (empty, newly registered, or its token paused in SYA), a 1-wei donation of its token bricks every harvest: (a) unrouted -> RouteNotConfigured(token); (b) routed -> Router NG reverts on dust (USDe route: 'Received nothing'; DOLA metapool route: empty revert data). On the live routes every amount < 1e13 wei reverts; 1e13 wei returns 9 USDC-wei.
findings.attackVector: Any EOA transfers 1 wei of e.g. DOLA to the harvester while the DOLA strategy has no surplus. Dust is permanent until a harvest in which that strategy delivers real yield (dust is then sold with it). Workaround: caller passes the strategy in exemptStrategies; but in case (b) harvest.sh can only print an opaque 'execution reverted' with no token named, so the operator cannot tell which strategy to exempt. Same failure occurs without any griefer if a strategy naturally delivers sub-1e13-wei yield.
findings.impact: Liveness/operator friction; no fund loss (tx reverts).
findings.recommendation: Snapshot strategy-token balances before sya.claim and sell only the delta (or skip balances below a dust threshold / skip tokens SYA reports paused); add an owner sweep for strays.

findings.description: src/CLAUDE.md defines a profitable claim as `market value - discounted USDC payment > gas + NFT cost`, and the contract claims it 'refuses to complete unless the ETH returned covers that gas'. Neither the on-chain Unprofitable check nor harvest.sh's floor (gasLimit*maxFee + MIN_PROFIT_WEI, default 0) prices the claim NFT that SYA burns.
findings.attackVector: No attacker: operator self-loss under defaults. Live NFTMinter getPrice(1) = 10,782,880 USDC-wei (primeToken USDC) = $10.78. The story-005 anvil run (reproduced) nets the operator 0.003649871 ETH after gas (~$8.5 at the current V4 pool price ~2,340 USDC/ETH) and reports 'success' while burning an NFT that costs ~$10.78 to replace: a net loss of ~$2.3 per harvest, with every guard green.
findings.impact: Caller value loss under default script configuration; spec (CLAUDE.md purpose) not faithfully implemented.
findings.recommendation: In harvest.sh, read nftMinter.getPrice(NFT_INDEX), convert to ETH (V4 pool slot0 or the simulated USDC/ETH rate) and add it to GAS_FLOOR; default MIN_PROFIT_WEI to that value or refuse to run without it. Document the NFT cost in the README.
findings.evidence: cast call 0x39Af...E10F getPrice(1) -> 10782880; dispatcher 0x9cd4...19f3b3 primeToken() -> USDC; harvest_anvil.sh case 5 'operator ETH rose by 3649871151856064 wei net of gas'.
findings.confidence: medium (USD equivalence depends on ETH price; the omission itself is certain)

findings.description: Routes' final token and ethPool.currency1 are checked against sya.rewardToken() only at set time; unlockCallback reads it live. After the SYA owner calls setRewardToken, every harvest reverts; the harvester owner cannot pre-stage the new configuration because setRoute/setEthPool validate against the CURRENT reward token (old pool key rejected InvalidEthPool after the switch, new one rejected before it), so a harvest outage between two independent owner actions is unavoidable. Also the old reward token's strategy (YS_USDC) silently needs a route.
findings.attackVector: Owner footgun across two contracts/owners: not obvious from SYA's side that a reward-token migration bricks the public harvester.
findings.impact: Fail-loud DoS until re-registration; no fund loss.
findings.reconciliation: Distinct from stable-yield-accumulator M-02 (fingerprint 5292756503, status fixed: setRewardToken re-keying the nudge stream bricked claim()). That guard (story-027 NudgeStreamNotRegistered) still applies and had to be mocked to reach the harvester-side brick; this finding is the harvester's own cached-config coupling and should not be filed against SYA.
findings.recommendation: Check `Currency.unwrap(ethPool.currency1) == sya.rewardToken()` at the top of harvest with a named error; document 'clear/re-register harvester routes + ethPool' in the SYA reward-token migration runbook.

findings.description: Borrow and SYA allowance = calculateClaimAmount*1.01. Measured per strategy on fork, paid/estimate: USDC strategy 99.00%, USDe 75.12%, DOLA 100.00% (exact). The NatSpec premise 'calculateClaimAmount already over-estimates by ~10% on live strategies' is false for DOLA, which runs with only the 1% buffer as headroom. Any strategy whose skimSurplus delivers > estimate*1.01 makes SYA's safeTransferFrom revert (allowance), i.e. a loud DoS requiring the caller to exempt it. No current revert observed. MockSYA can only over-estimate, so this path is untested.

Confirmed code path: with sqrtPriceLimitX96 = MAX_SQRT_PRICE-1 a liquidity-exhausted swap partially fills and the unswapped reward token stays for the next caller. Unreachable on the configured ETH/USDC 0.3% pool at harvest sizes (~$10-30). Not exploitable by a third party against an honest caller (minEthOut covers the caller). QA.

(1) test_noHarvestFunction calls harvest(uint256,uint256,address[]) — a selector that never existed — so it asserts nothing (vacuous). (2) MockCurveRouter derives tokenOut as the last non-zero path entry, copying the harvester's own validation rule; this is exactly why CODE-001 is invisible to the unit suite. (3) MockSYA estimate is >= delivered by construction, so CODE-005's revert path is unexercised. None of these is a vulnerability; they reduce the suite's ability to catch CODE-001/CODE-005 regressions.

Reviewed bash/cast/bc end to end. Sound: integer-wei bc maths (truncating division; all outputs far below bc's 70-char line-wrap; SLIPPAGE_BPS<=10000 keeps SLIPPED non-negative); fee fields reach tx.gasprice in eth_call (case 2b reproduced: Unprofitable(3976593410276056, 27958755523154736) decoded); the script's own floor gasLimit*maxFeePerGas (maxFee = 2*baseFee+tip) is >= any inclusion-time gas cost, so even a provider that ignored fee fields in eth_call (Unprofitable trivially passing) could not cause an under-protected send; parse failures die via isuint rather than sending; no public-mempool fallback (send only to PRIVATE_RPC_URL, chain-id cross-checked); raw keys refused, password only via file/prompt. Minor residuals: (a) no deadline — minEthOut binds, but a Flashbots-Protect tx may land several blocks later; (b) on `cast send` timeout the script dies 'cast send failed' although the private tx may still land, and an immediate re-run builds a second tx (it will revert ZeroAmount/NFT pull, costing gas); (c) for router-dust/empty-revert cases decode_revert yields no token name (see CODE-002); (d) PRIVATE_RPC_URL is not checked to be a private relay (operator choice). NFT cost omission filed separately as CODE-003.

clearedRows.classicSingleFnReentrancy: ETH payout is the last statement of harvest; all checks precede it.
clearedRows.crossContractReentrancy: Any re-entry into harvest from inside unlockCallback (strategy skimSurplus, Curve pools, SYA downstream phlimbo/nudge) reverts AlreadyUnlocked in PoolManager; unlockCallback/receive gated to poolManager. Grep of sibling first-party sources (phlimbo-ea, phoenix-nft-staking, stable-yield-accumulator) finds no V4 unlock on the claim path; fork end-to-end passes with all strategies non-exempt.
clearedRows.crossFunctionReentrancy: Only owner-gated siblings (setRoute/clearRoute/setEthPool) share state; not reachable by untrusted callees.
clearedRows.readOnlyReentrancy: No public view usable as a price/oracle (getRoute/getEthPool are config reads).
clearedRows.erc1155RefundHook (MR-04): Refund safeTransferFrom -> msg.sender.onERC1155Received runs before ethOut is read; a re-entrant harvest reads/pays the outer call's ETH to the same caller and the outer call then fails its own minEthOut. Only the caller's own value is in flight; no third-party victim. Also dormant today (live SYA always burns).
clearedRows.wholeBalancePayout / forcedEth: address(this).balance payout and forced ETH (selfdestruct or a third party's PoolManager.take to the harvester) only add value to the current caller and can only make that caller's own checks easier to pass; no path lets a non-caller extract an honest caller's ETH. Stray assets are a gift to the next caller (user error, LOCAL-004).
clearedRows.nftApprovalChain: NFT pull is always from msg.sender; a caller cannot consume another holder's setApprovalForAll, nor free-ride on stray NFT units held by the harvester (pull of 1 unit from the caller always precedes the claim when minter != 0).
clearedRows.staticFalsePositives: SLITHER-001 (ETH to arbitrary user) = intended payout to msg.sender; ADERYN-001/002 reentrancy in setRoute/setEthPool = owner-only, external call is a view on SYA; SLITHER-028/015/033 ignored returns = BalanceDelta/settle/exchange amounts are not needed (balances read directly).
